mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES continues edging up while TRANSIT stays depressed, more weekday trips will be commute-linked and can spill into nearby retail visits, pushing RETAIL_REC slightly higher over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not rise above its last-4-week mean even as WORKPLACES keeps increasing and TRANSIT remains below -65 for the next 4 weeks.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in RESIDENTIAL mobility indicates more time spent outside home, and that shift should raise casual shopping and dining trips, lifting RETAIL_REC within two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC stays flat or falls over the next 14 days despite RESIDENTIAL remaining below its current level.

mechanism_narrative: If TRANSIT moves up by at least 5 points from its current level, the city is likely relaxing movement constraints enough to support more discretionary trips, which should raise RETAIL_REC over four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT rises by at least 5 points from the current weekly mean
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to increase after TRANSIT posts a week-on-week gain of 5 points or more and stays above that higher level.

mechanism_narrative: When PARKS and TRANSIT improve together, it signals broader out-of-home activity and weekend foot traffic that later spills into retail districts, raising RETAIL_REC over the following month.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not outperform its last-4-week average even after PARKS and TRANSIT both rise for two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: A short-lived rebound in PARKS mobility is a warm-weather signal that precedes more leisure shopping and eating out, so RETAIL_REC should increase within one week if PARKS keeps recovering.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises at least 3 points week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not rise in the next week after PARKS gains 3 points or more from the prior week.

mechanism_narrative: If GROCERY_PHARM remains near zero while RESIDENTIAL keeps falling, household needs are being met without much stay-at-home substitution, leaving more room for discretionary retail visits and a higher RETAIL_REC over four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC remains below its prior 4-week average even though GROCERY_PHARM stays between -2 and 0 and RESIDENTIAL keeps trending lower.

mechanism_narrative: A further decline in WORKPLACES below -35 would mark a renewed tightening of in-person activity, and that should suppress discretionary shopping trips, driving RETAIL_REC lower over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises or stays flat over the next 14 days after WORKPLACES drops below -35.

mechanism_narrative: Because RETAIL_REC has been less negative while WORKPLACES improves and TRANSIT remains deeply suppressed, the current pattern reflects localized recovery rather than broad reopening; if that mix persists, retail mobility should keep rising over the next month.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not exceed -35 on average over the next 28 days while WORKPLACES continues to improve and TRANSIT stays below -70.
